policy.rule_if_card_requested: stop, do not enter card, pick fallback, log the incident here

services.terms_note: static sites only, no server-side code; commercial use allowed

services.terms_note: verify current free plan wording before adopting

services.limits: no automatic backups on free tier; 10M cells per file
services.terms_note: no PII beyond contact fields; no medical data ever

services.role: source of truth for doctor availability
services.limits: read/write quotas change without notice; availability reads cached 30s

services.role: optional administrative assistant (never in booking decisions)
services.limits: free tier limits were reduced in Dec 2025 — read live limits in AI Studio; this app caps itself at LLM_DAILY_LIMIT (25) and LLM_HOURLY_LIMIT (20)

services.role: fallback LLM provider for the administrative assistant
services.limits: free tier with per-minute and per-day token limits — verify live in console
services.terms_note: add a PROVIDERS entry before relying on it; do not send PII

services.limits: 15 GB shared with Gmail and Photos; ~750 GB/day upload soft cap; 12k requests/min per user

services.role: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client for the system account's refresh token
services.limits: no cost; 100 refresh tokens per client per account (oldest invalidated)

known_card_required_avoided.reason: billed per delivered message, and without a payment method delivery stops once a number's 1,000 free service messages for the month are used; adopted here only as an off/dry-run adapter — see docs/prd/whatsapp-cloud-api.md

sources.verified: Since 2026-10-01 service messages are billed per message; each business phone number gets 1,000 free service messages per month (no roll-over), charged from the 1,001st. Every template (marketing, utility, authentication) is billed per delivered message; service messages are the non-template replies. Billing happens on delivery only. Without a payment method on the account, service messages are still delivered inside the 1,000-message monthly allowance and are NOT delivered after it — so a card-free account works for replies up to that ceiling and for nothing else.

A test business phone number is generated and registered automatically by the Get Started flow; a number already in use with WhatsApp cannot be registered unless it is deleted first (and deletion is blocked while paid messages were sent in the last 30 days); registration requires a two-step-verification PIN plus an SMS or voice code. Recipients must be in E.164 form: if the leading plus sign is omitted, Meta prepends the BUSINESS number's country calling code — the documented example turns (631) 555-1234 into +916315551234 — so a local form such as 01113593643 would become +2001113593643 and be misrouted. A new business portfolio is initially capped at two registered business phone numbers, rising to 20 after business verification (or at the 2,000-number limit).

unverified: the maximum number of recipients a test number may message (not stated on the pages read; the two-number figure on the phone-numbers page is a cap on registered business numbers per portfolio, not on recipients)

whether a given Graph API version is still served, and for how long: neither page states a support window; their examples use v23.0 and v27.0, while WhatsApp.gs previously pinned v21.0 — the version is now a validated setting with a v23.0 default
known_card_required_avoided.note: Access to Cloud API itself is free; messages are billed. This entry exists because the adapter is adopted in dry-run only. Two consequences recorded 2026-11-05: replies inside the monthly 1,000 are deliverable without a card, and the recipient format is E.164 on the wire (fixed in WhatsApp.gs, which now also takes the Graph version from a validated setting).
